# Timers sub-actions

## Get timer state

Looks up a timer from the Timers page and tells you if it is on, how often it runs and how long until it goes off next.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | The timer's name, exactly as on the Timers page. The default %timerName% is the timer that started this action. Starts as: `%timerName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timerEnabled%` | True if the timer is on |
| `%timerInterval%` | How many seconds the timer waits between runs |
| `%timerSecondsRemaining%` | Seconds until it goes off next (-1 if it is not counting down) |
| `%timerRepeat%` | True if the timer repeats |
| `%timerChatLines%` | How many chat messages came in since it last ran |
| `%timerStateName%` | The timer's name |

<small>Type id: `timers.getState`</small>

## Set timer state

Turns a timer from the Timers page on, off or flips it, and can change how often it runs. Handy to speed up reminders when chat is busy. Not saved after a restart.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | The timer's name, exactly as on the Timers page. |
| **State** | Enable turns it on. Disable turns it off. Toggle switches it to the opposite. No change leaves it as it is. Options: No change, Enable, Disable, Toggle. Starts as: `Enable`. |
| **Interval (seconds)** | A new wait between runs in whole seconds, like 600 for 10 minutes. Empty keeps the current time. |

<small>Type id: `timers.setState`</small>
